_about: Long-arc questions and secrets. 'forbidden_terms' may not appear in any dialogue line before the secret is revealed, unless the line is spoken by someone in known_by AND the episode lists the secret under reveals.

questions.question: What is a Lapse?
questions.season1: reveal part of how it works, not its origin

questions.question: Who is uploading these files?
questions.season1: a strong answer or clue at the finale

secrets.truth: Recovery Team 04 existed; Holloway was on it; their SRS beacon was left inside a Lapse.
Team 04 went missing on an assignment and their file was never closed.
Someone inside Wayfarer changed the RT-04 beacon's registration to UNREGISTERED.
At least one Team 04 member may still be alive inside a Lapse.
Team 04's assignment may have caused the shutdown.
The SRS core was recovered from the first Lapse: they observe anomalies with an anomaly.
Stabilizer is refined from Salvage; only Wayfarer can make it.
What the program is really for (to be decided before FILE 15).
The archive is not historical: recording status is LIVE.
